findings.claim: Acceptance requires complete supplied visibility into the task-scoped implementation evidence relevant to the runtime producer-context goal.
findings.observed: The caller-computed diff visibility contract is complete=false and truncated=true; it lists omitted implementation and test paths and a partial OpenAPI path, so those paths were not reviewed.
findings.rationale: The supplied blocker artifacts support the permitted no-integration branch, but incomplete visibility prevents a trustworthy final semantic determination and must not be converted into either an implementation-absence finding or ACCEPT.
findings.required: Provide a complete caller-scoped diff or equivalent supplied evidence covering the omitted and partial goal-relevant paths, then rerun acceptance without inferring absence from unsupplied files.

goals.summary: Monitoring runtime: dokončit producer context až nad doloženým execution-owner kontraktem
